title: Toward Methods and Tools for Critical Examination of Disparate Systems for Discovery of Hidden Dependencies in Engineering of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.34974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a methodology, an initial AI Skill package, and emerging results, for enhancing software engineers' acquisition and application of domain knowledge and system-wide engineering perspectives towards the development of an autonomous or semi-autonomous system in a domain that may be new to them. At the core of the approach is a process involving proactive adversarial critiquing of videos of disparate systems in related environments. Among other things, the engineers and automated AI tools look for interactions, dependencies, and environment assumptions manifested in the observed systems, which are applicable also to the target system, but that otherwise might remain unarticulated in project artifacts. The approach and its supporting tools can enhance the quality of the target system, the individual engineer's skills and the organization's engineering practices.

translated_title: 面向自主与半自主系统工程中通过批判性考察异构系统以发现隐藏依赖关系的方法与工具
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种方法论、一个初步的AI技能包以及初步成果，旨在增强软件工程师在开发其可能较为陌生的领域中的自主或半自主系统时，对领域知识的获取与应用能力以及系统级工程视角。该方法的核心是一个对相关环境中异构系统视频进行主动对抗性批判分析的过程。工程师和自动化AI工具在观察到的系统中寻找交互、依赖关系和环境假设，这些内容同样适用于目标系统，否则可能会在项目工件中一直未被明确表述。该方法及其支持工具能够提升目标系统的质量、工程师个人的技能以及组织的工程实践。
tldr: 本文提出一种通过对相关环境中异构系统视频进行主动对抗性批判分析的方法论和AI工具，用于发现隐藏的依赖关系和环境假设，帮助软件工程师在陌生领域开发自主/半自主系统时获取领域知识并提升系统质量与工程实践。
